findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true regardless of the arguments authorizes a user from one tenant to read documents belonging to any other tenant. Callers relying on this exported authorization helper lose tenant isolation, creating a direct cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
